name: supo-codegym-2nodeprobe-h100
description: 2 x 1-GPU probe: Arnold multi-node env vars + cross-node reachability + ray head/worker bootstrap

job_template_config.entrypoint_full_script: echo "NODE id=$ARNOLD_ID host=$(hostname) ip4=$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)"; env | grep -E '^(ARNOLD_(ID|WORKER|NUM|ROLE|EXECUTOR|MERLIN_INTERNAL_0|TRIAL|RUN)|MERLIN|RANK|WORLD|MASTER)' | grep -v 'CURRENT_PORT' | sort | head -40; echo "--- ports"; env | grep -E '^ARNOLD_MERLIN_INTERNAL_[0-1]_' ; echo "--- reachability"; for h in $(env | grep -oE 'ARNOLD_WORKER_[0-9]+_HOST=.*' | cut -d= -f2); do ping -c1 -W2 $h >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "PING $h ok" || echo "PING $h FAIL"; done; PY=/usr/bin/python3; which ray || true; exit 0
